name: Ross Stores
outlook:
What Ross Stores says to expect

  • Third and fourth quarter 2026: comparable store salesComparable store sales are now expected to increase 6% to 7% in the third quarter and 4% to 5% in the fourth quarter.
  • Fiscal 2026: earnings per shareBased on our strong first half results and our updated second half guidance, we are increasing our 2026 fiscal year earnings per share projections to be in the range of $8.61 to $8.77, which again includes an approximate $0.60 earnings per share benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds recognized in the second quarter.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed August 20, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
